title: People Ops - manager prep / self notes Q1 2026
content:
Purpose: quick notes for upcoming 1:1 with my manager, quarterly self-review input, and draft talking points for calibration.

TL;DR: Overall progress on hiring targets (on track), need clearer exec alignment on compensation band refresh, want to propose a trial of peer interview debrief templates and a hiring channel for IC candidate feedback.

Open items / questions to bring up:
- Compensation band refresh timeline: finance said Q1, but product org expecting changes later. Need clarity on rollout and communication plan. (Linked Confluence above.)
- Request: run a short audit of offer acceptance reasons last 6 months (recruiting -> exit interviews + candidate feedback). Who owns? Ops or Recruiting?
- Feedback loop: Interview feedback quality is inconsistent. Idea: pilot a one-week interviewer calibration + debrief template. Want manager sign-off to run with Recruiting for one team (Platform Eng).

Metrics / evidence to cite:
- Hiring: 6 offers extended in Jan-Feb, 5 accepted, 1 declined (counteroffer). Offer-to-accept rate: 83%. Time-to-offer median: 22 days (goal 21).
- Attrition: voluntary churn last 12 months: 7%. No spikes this quarter.
- Candidate NPS: average 8.1 from our post-process survey (sample size 48).

What I did this quarter (evidence for calibration/self-review):
- Hired recruiting panel structure and interviewer training for SRE and Serving Runtime roles; ran 3 sessions, trained 24 interviewers.
- Launched weekly recruiting sync with eng leads to tighten role definitions -> reduced rework on job descriptions by ~30%.
- Led compensation benchmarking exercise with Finance for mid-Senior IC bands (rough draft completed, Confluence doc updated).
- Ran two manager training sessions: "comp conversations" and "effective feedback" (slides + attendance list in Confluence).

Impact examples / stories to call out in 1:1:
- Reduced time-to-fill for critical infra hire from 45 days to 28 days after streamlining on-site schedule and interviewer mapping. Saved ~12k in contractor costs for project work.
- Candidate feedback that prompted process change: multiple candidates reported lack of clarity about on-call expectations - updated JD templates and interviewer checklist.

Development goals (next cycle):
- Short-term (next 3 months): finalize compensation band proposal and communicate to managers; pilot interviewer debrief template in Platform Eng and measure feedback quality improvements.
- Medium (6 months): build a lightweight interviewer scorecard + automated reminders in Greenhouse to improve completeness of feedback.
- Long-term (12 months): partner with Eng managers to roll out a manager enablement program focused on career conversations and calibration across org.

Ask from manager:
- Approval to pilot debrief template with Platform Eng and 2 hiring managers.
- Support to prioritize compensation band work with Finance leadership (ask for weekly 30m sync for 6 weeks).
- Guidance on calibration evidence needed for promotion conversations in June.

Prep notes for 1:1 (bullet prompts):
- Quick hiring metric update (use numbers above).
- Ask: green light to run pilot + headcount reprioritization if needed.
- Raise compensation timeline and recommend communication draft for managers (offer to draft).
- Ask for feedback on leadership behaviors: where to focus to get to next level (specific examples).

Risks / mitigation:
- Risk: Compensation changes leak early -> communications plan + holding statement needed.
- Risk: Pilot doesn't get traction with engineers -> include manager champions and keep pilot small.

Notes to self / TODOs after 1:1:
- Draft pilot template and circulate to Alex Chen and Maya Singh for quick feedback (action: Sophie).
- Schedule weekly 30m sync with Finance (action: Sophie + Finance lead).
- Pull last 6 months of offer decline reasons and create a one-pager (action: Recruiting ops).

Random scratchpad ideas (not ready to propose yet):
- Lightweight "candidate experience" heatmap for each role (visualization idea).
- Small reward for interviewers who provide high-quality feedback (recognition in all-hands).

References / links to follow-up:
- Confluence: HR/performance-cycle-2026 (draft compensation bands)
- JIRA: HR-482 (comp band tracking)
- Slack: #people-ops thread "comp-band-discussion" (pin important messages)

Status: draft - will refine after chat with Alex and Maya.

Quick personal note: keep 1:1 focused on decision items; avoid getting into operational weeds unless asked.
